title: Ribéry 2013: the deadline that moved
checked: Bayern 2012-13 treble (Wikipedia final page, TNT). Final 25 May 2013 Wembley, Dortmund 1-2 Bayern, Mandzukic 60, Gundogan pen 68, Robben 89 from Ribery's back-heel, low left foot from about eight yards past Weidenfeller (Wikipedia, FT.lk). UEFA Best Player in Europe 2013 (UEFA, TNT); 'widely tipped to win' (TNT, Goal). Deadline 15 Nov moved to 29 Nov, announced 20 Nov, first extension ever, FIFA said too few voters had replied (Wikipedia, TNT, Fox). Sweden 2-3 Portugal in Stockholm 19 Nov, Ronaldo hat-trick, Ibrahimovic two (Fox, TNT). Result 27.99/24.72/23.36%, 1365/1205/1127 points, ceremony 13 Jan 2014 (Wikipedia, NBC, Afrik-foot). FIFA said the extension did not decide it (Fox); Ribery called it an injustice (beIN, Goal). 'Voters could change their picks' dropped: only one source. Robben goal recreated with gamecap (specs/ribery-2013.json).

lines.text: Franck Ribéry won the treble. Then FIFA moved the goalposts.
lines.say: Frank Reebairee won the treble. Then Feefa moved the goalposts.

lines.text: In 2012-13, Bayern swept the lot: the Bundesliga, the German Cup and the Champions League.
lines.say: In twenty twelve, thirteen, Byern swept the lot: the Boondesleega, the German Cup, and the Champions League.

lines.text: Wembley. The final against Dortmund. One-all, and a minute to go.
lines.say: Wembley. The final, against Dortmoond. One all, and a minute to go.

lines.text: Ribéry back-heels it. Robben is through. Two-one, Bayern.
lines.say: Reebairee back heels it. Robbun is through. Two, one, Byern.

lines.text: UEFA named Ribéry the best player in Europe. He was the clear favourite for the Ballon d'Or.
lines.say: Yooayfa named Reebairee the best player in Europe. He was the clear favourite for the Balon Dor.

lines.text: Voting was meant to close on the fifteenth of November.
Then FIFA extended it by two weeks. The first time ever. The reason? Not enough votes in.
lines.say: Then Feefa extended it by two weeks. The first time ever. The reason? Not enough votes in.

scene.headline: FIFA extends Ballon d'Or voting
scene.standfirst: The deadline moves from 15 to 29 November, the first extension in the award's history. FIFA says too few voters have replied.

lines.text: And in those two weeks, a World Cup play-off in Stockholm. Zlatan's Sweden against Ronaldo's Portugal.
lines.say: And in those two weeks, a World Cup play-off in Stockholm. Zlatan's Sweden, against Ronaldo's Portugal.

lines.text: Zlatan scores twice. Ronaldo scores three. Portugal win three-two and go to Brazil.

scene.note: Ronaldo hat-trick · Portugal through 4-2 on aggregate

lines.text: January. Ronaldo wins it. Messi second. Ribéry third.
lines.say: January. Ronaldo wins it. Messi second. Reebairee third.

lines.text: Twenty-eight percent against twenty-three. The treble winner, five points behind.
lines.say: Twenty eight percent, against twenty three. The treble winner, five points behind.

lines.text: FIFA said the extension changed nothing. Ribéry called it an injustice.
lines.say: Feefa said the extension changed nothing. Reebairee called it an injustice.

scene.headline: Ribéry hits out after finishing third
scene.standfirst: The Bayern winger calls the result an injustice. FIFA says the extra fortnight had nothing to do with Ronaldo's win.

lines.text: Would the old deadline have changed it? Nobody can know.
A treble, the best player in Europe, and no Ballon d'Or. Robbed?
lines.say: A treble, the best player in Europe, and no Balon Dor. Robbed?

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
